boss.description: Every week a boss shows up with a health pool shared by the whole squad. Every hit anyone lands drains it. Bring it down before Sunday night, or it survives into the next fight.
boss.title: One boss, one shared health bar

challenges.description: Every Monday, five challenges are drawn from a catalogue of 46, one per tier. The tougher it is, the bigger the damage bonus.

boss.body: Every week a boss stands in the squad's way with its own pool of hit points. Your matches and challenges chip away at it, and it has to fall before Sunday 11:59 pm. Miss that, and it survives the week.
boss.title: This week's opponent

challenges.body: Five challenges are drawn every week, from the easiest to the nastiest. The harder the challenge, the more it costs the boss. The bar tracks what the squad has cleared so far, one challenge at a time.
challenges.title: Five challenges, five tiers

intro.body: Seven players, one week, one territory to take back. Everything you play in Valorant counts: every match feeds the squad's effort and your standing in the group. One minute to get the loop.
intro.title: One week, one expedition

players.body: Every tracked player has their own page: competitive rank, match history and detailed statistics. That is the broad strokes — the rules page covers the points, the bonuses and the exact numbers.
players.title: Seven profiles to follow

ranking.body: Everyone's damage adds up into a weekly ranking. Showing up regularly and clearing challenges together earn bonuses on top. Whoever leads when the week closes takes the Champion title.
ranking.title: Who hits hardest
